title: 第9章 迟来的见面礼第10章 威名
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
……不错个屁。
这老头不仅每天监督他砍竹子盖房子，要是盖的不好，还会动手拆掉。
这一拆，基本就相当于从头再来。
朔衡倒是没什么洁癖，毕竟他现在已经有属于自己的小吊床了，也算不用继续在泥地里睡觉。
但眼看自己的竹屋来回翻修十几遍……算了，还能怎样呢，又打不过。
——
两月后。
洺万里手里抓着一个酒壶，坐在林间，看着朔衡忙来忙去的身影。
他倒不是刻意捉弄朔衡。
只是朔衡还太小了，根本没法修炼。
既然不能修炼，那就只能先打打基础。
修炼。
正所谓三分靠天赋，七分靠打拼。
朔衡的天赋已然占了三分，那剩下的，就是靠后天的努力了。
其实恐怕连朔衡自己都想不到，这一眼望去茂盛葱郁看不到尽头的竹林中的每一棵竹子，都是上等的灵竹。
青翠挺拔，坚韧无比，寻常凡人根本无法斩断。
太初峰灵气浓郁，是因为有一个巨大的聚灵阵被布置在山下。
只要聚灵阵不毁，灵气就能源源不断，永不枯竭。
所以生长在此地无数年的竹子，怎么可能不是珍品？
这也是朔衡一开始根本砍不动它的原因。

然而随着时间流逝，数不清的气血充盈之物被朔衡吃进小肚子里。
小孩的身量长高了些，手臂甚至肉眼可见的多了一层薄薄的肌肉纹理。
噔！
一斧子下去，几乎在粗壮的竹竿上嵌入了将近一半。
洺万里满意的眯起眼睛，仰头倒了口酒喝。
朔衡的天赋，确实是平生罕见。
他有意从小就认真磨砺的徒弟，虽然嘴上会吐槽他“残忍”，经常坑他的灵药灵宝，甚至懒散的时候也很欠打……
但他总是在努力完成自己交给他的任务，即便看起来一副不走心的样子。
“小徒弟，来，过来歇会儿。”
洺万里招招手示意人过来。
朔衡扫了这老头一眼，随即扔掉手里的破烂斧头——在朔衡眼里，这斧头被用了这么久还没坏也是个奇迹。
他走到洺万里身边，从空间戒指里取出来一把竹椅放在地上，这才施施然坐了上去。
同样是他用山里的灵竹做的，刚好适合他身高的小凳子。
没办法。
直接往地上坐的行为，实在不太符合他大家族嫡系的身份。
content_en:
...not bad.
The old man not only supervised him cutting bamboo to build a house every day, but would also tear it down if the construction was not good.
This dismantling is basically equivalent to starting over from scratch.
Shuo Heng didn't have any mysophobia. After all, he now had his own little hammock, so he no longer had to sleep in the mud.
But seeing my bamboo house renovated over a dozen times... forget it, what else can I do, and I can't beat it.
——
Two months later.
Ming Wanli held a wine bottle in his hand and sat in the forest, watching Shuo Heng's busy figure.
He didn't deliberately tease Shuo Heng.
It’s just that Shuo Heng is still too young and can’t practice at all.
Since you can't practice, you can only lay the foundation first.
Practice.
As the saying goes, three points depend on talent and seven points depend on hard work.
Shuo Heng's talent already accounts for three thirds, and the rest depends on his hard work.
In fact, I am afraid that even Shuo Heng himself could not have imagined that every bamboo in the lush and endless bamboo forest at a glance was a top-quality spiritual bamboo.
Green and tall, it is extremely tough and cannot be cut off by ordinary mortals.
Taichu Peak has strong spiritual energy because there is a huge spirit gathering array arranged at the foot of the mountain.
As long as the spirit gathering array is not destroyed, the spiritual energy will have an endless supply and will never be exhausted.
So how could the bamboo that has grown here for countless years not be a treasure?
This was also the reason why Shuo Heng couldn't cut it at all at first.
However, as time passed, countless things filled with energy and blood were eaten by Shuo Heng into his belly.
The child has grown taller, and his arms even have a thin layer of muscle texture visible to the naked eye.
Bang!
With one stroke of the ax, it was almost halfway embedded in the thick bamboo pole.
Ming Wanli narrowed his eyes with satisfaction, raised his head and took a sip of wine.
Shuo Heng's talent is indeed rare in his life.
He has been an apprentice who has been training seriously since he was a child. Although he will complain about his "cruelty", he often cheats on his elixirs and treasures, and he even needs a beating when he is lazy...
But he always strives to complete the tasks assigned to him, even if he seems to be careless.
"Little apprentice, come on, come over and have a rest."
Ming Wanli waved for people to come over.
Shuo Heng glanced at the old man, and then threw away the broken ax in his hand - in Shuo Heng's eyes, it was a miracle that the ax had not broken after being used for so long.
He walked to Ming Wanli, took out a bamboo chair from the space ring and placed it on the ground, then Shi Shiran sat on it.
It was also made of bamboo from the mountains and was a small stool that was just right for his height.
no way.
The behavior of sitting directly on the ground is really not in line with his status as a direct descendant of a large family.
